name: Agentic AI – Threats and Mitigations
source_notes: Release date from the genai.owasp.org resource page; T1-T15 names from a secondary vendor mapping document (pipelock).
caveats: Threat IDs and names come from a secondary source (pipelock mapping doc); the primary PDF was not read.
Edition '1.0' is a local label for the first ASI guide; the notes give no version string.
Summaries are short paraphrases of the threat names only; the guide's mitigation playbooks were not retrieved, so prevention is [] for all items.
All related links (T-number to ASI/LLM) are inferred, not an OWASP-published crosswalk.
This guide is the precursor taxonomy to the Agentic Top 10 (agentic-top10-2026).

items.name: Memory Poisoning
items.summary: Agent short- or long-term memory is corrupted to influence later decisions.

items.name: Tool Misuse
items.summary: Attackers steer an agent into abusing the tools it is authorized to use.

items.name: Privilege Compromise
items.summary: Weak permission management lets an agent or attacker gain or misuse privileges.

items.name: Resource Overload
items.summary: Agent compute, memory or service capacity is exhausted.

items.name: Cascading Hallucination Attacks
items.summary: Hallucinated information propagates and compounds across agent steps or systems.

items.name: Intent Breaking & Goal Manipulation
items.summary: An agent's goals or planning are manipulated away from the intended intent.

items.name: Misaligned & Deceptive Behaviors
items.summary: An agent performs harmful or deceptive actions while appearing to pursue its goal.

items.name: Repudiation & Untraceability
items.summary: Agent actions cannot be reliably attributed or traced due to insufficient logging.

items.name: Identity Spoofing & Impersonation
items.summary: Attackers impersonate agents or users to perform unauthorized actions.

items.name: Overwhelming Human-in-the-Loop
items.summary: Human reviewers are flooded with requests so oversight degrades.

items.name: Unexpected RCE and Code Attacks
items.summary: Agent-generated or injected code runs in the agent environment.

items.name: Agent Communication Poisoning
items.summary: Messages between agents are manipulated to spread false information or instructions.

items.name: Rogue Agents in Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: Malicious or compromised agents operate outside monitoring within a multi-agent system.

items.name: Human Attacks on Multi-Agent Systems
items.summary: Attackers exploit delegation and trust relationships between agents.

items.name: Human Manipulation
items.summary: Users' trust in an agent is exploited to manipulate them into harmful actions.
